items.html: Now the first correction of the beard, which begins from the end of the corners of the head, as above, is the Malchut of the Hochma, as mentioned there. Thus it is found that the Malchut of the head, which is the corner (pe'a), bestows and attaches to the Malchut that is in the first correction of the beard — Malchut to Malchut. And from those hairs of the corners of the head, the Malchut of the skull, the flow descends to the hairs of the first correction of the beard, the Malchut within it, and from there to the rest of the thirteen corrections.
